rules.description: Find the payment-terms clause. Extract the number of days the Buyer has to pay (e.g. 'Net 15', 'Net 30', '45 days from invoice').
rules.fallback_text: The Buyer shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of the date of a valid invoice.

rules.description: Find the service-level clause. Extract the measurable SLA target and the service-credit rule.
rules.walk_away: No measurable SLA for a service contract
rules.fallback_text: The Supplier shall meet a measurable service level of at least 95% on-time performance per month, with service credits of 5% of the monthly fee per percentage point missed, capped at 20% of the monthly fee.

rules.description: Determine whether the contract involves processing of personal data and whether a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or equivalent clause is present.
rules.fallback: Supplier commits to sign a DPA before go-live
rules.walk_away: No DPA where personal data is processed
rules.fallback_text: The parties shall enter into a Data Processing Agreement consistent with applicable data protection law before any processing of personal data commences.
